Powerful Features That Deliver Results

Everything you need to take control of your Bluesky network

Real-time Follower Tracking

Instantly see when someone follows or unfollows you with live updates.

Fix Followings

Automatically remove deleted, suspended, deactivated or blocked accounts to correct inaccurate Bluesky following counts.

Learn More

Block & Mute Management

See who has blocked you and manage your blocks and mutes effectively.

Daily, Weekly & Monthly Reports

Get breakdowns of your Bluesky activity with reports that track follower growth, posts, and performance over time.

Interactive Charts & Trends

Understand your growth at a glance with interactive charts for followers, followings, and engagement over time.

Advanced Filtering

Filter users based on keywords, followers count, follower-to-following ratio, engagement, and activity level.

Lists & Starter Packs

View lists that have blocked you and discover starter packs you're included in or lists you are blocking/muting to better understand your Bluesky presence.

Bulk Follow & Unfollow

Follow or unfollow users in bulk to efficiently manage your Bluesky network.

Bookmarks Support & Search

View your saved posts in Bluesky and easily search for those posts by keywords or author.

Post Analytics

Detailed metrics for any user's posts including reach, replies, and engagement.

Account & Relationship History

Track when you followed someone and when they followed you back, plus check past usernames for any account to verify identity and name changes.

Likes Timeline

See posts liked by any user on Bluesky, including yourself, to explore interests and engagement patterns.
